name: Face Your Ears
summary:
Face Your Ears is a spatial audio sampler designed to help users appreciate how audio can make VR more immersive! It's also a great app to share with family and friends who are new to VR.

Experience the thrill of being chased by bees or the adrenaline rush of narrowly missing a speeding train! We created several scenes featuring 3D audio, environmental effects, and the Doppler effect. All experiences support 6DoF, allowing you to move around, turn in different directions, and even close your eyes to guess
